key_idea: Turning the wheel moves the lanterns around, but their order around the ring stays the same.
steps: Go around each wheel and look at how the yellow and blue lanterns sit next to each other.
Wheels A, B, D and E each have exactly 2 yellow lanterns side by side, and never 3.
Wheel C has 3 yellow lanterns in a row.
Turning a wheel cannot make 3 yellows sit together, so wheel C is different.
